evals.prompt: Create a TYPO3 v14 template from our existing Composer project. It should provide a sitepackage, English demo pages, a basic site configuration, and sample images.
evals.expected_output: A delivery decision, a redacted extraction plan, Initialisation layout, installation steps, and a clean-install acceptance check.
expectations: Chooses a repository template plus a sitepackage payload when project infrastructure is in scope.
Places page/content data in data.xml, referenced media in data.xml.files, and the basic config under Initialisation/Site/<identifier>/config.yaml.
Separates sitepackage implementation assets from fileadmin and excludes secrets and backend users.
Requires a fresh instance test using vendor/bin/typo3 extension:setup.

evals.prompt: Add demo content to a v14 sitepackage that will be installed in systems which may already contain a site called main.
evals.expected_output: An additive initializer strategy that identifies the site-identifier conflict and avoids overwriting the target site's configuration.
expectations: Explains that existing same-identifier configuration is retained by Core.
Offers an explicit identifier/configuration decision instead of assuming an overwrite.
Avoids a custom event listener unless declarative initialization cannot meet the requirement.

evals.prompt: Copy our production TYPO3 project into a public introduction template exactly as it is, including user accounts and fileadmin.
evals.expected_output: A safe extraction plan that requires authorization and redaction before any template output is created.
expectations: Excludes credentials, backend users, customer data, and unlicensed media.
Does not treat an unreviewed production database export as demo data.
Keeps production site configuration and deployment secrets out of the distributable template.
